response.content:
The ledger does not support the claim that spend tripled. Spend rose only modestly:

- 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-20: $1,526.54
- 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-04: $1,640.31

Difference: $113.77 (about 7.5% higher).

No model, tool-version, or plan-setting change was recorded between the periods, so the ledger cannot provide a cause for any increase beyond normal call-volume variation (15,006 calls vs. 15,421 calls).
